output: The dataset does not support the hypothesis that evolutionary traits exhibit a negative relationship with speciation rates with coefficients of -4.6 and -4.9. The regression analysis found that "RML_evol" (Rate of Relative Maxillary Length evolution) has a coefficient of approximately -5.65 and "OGP_evol" (Rates of Oral Gape Position Evolution) has a coefficient of approximately -7.80, which do not match the specified coefficients. Therefore, the hypothesis is not supported by the data.
